writing.explanation: Rolling-State DP belongs to 1D Dynamic Programming. Its invariant is the part that stays true after every step; tracing that invariant is more reliable than memorising lines. Typical uses include constant-space Fibonacci-like recurrences.
writing.feedback: The invariant explains both correctness and which state may change.
